desk.period: Year to 30 Sep 2026 (FY2026, incl. Q4 to Sep 2026)
desk.headline: Headline loss widens to 69 US cents from 15c on $319m impairments and weak pulp prices; Q1 FY27 profit seen below Q4
results: The loss for the year grew to $747m from $177m, and the headline loss per share widened to 69 US cents from 15c.
Special items cut earnings by $405m, mostly $319m of impairments and $26m of strategic project costs; forestry fair-value changes added a $269m loss.
Adjusted EBITDA fell 41% to $294m as pulp dollar prices averaged 6% lower and a stronger rand and higher costs weighed.
Q4 adjusted EBITDA was $99m (down 11%) and the Q4 loss narrowed to $116m from $194m.
Net debt rose to $2.05bn from $1.92bn as operations used cash; lenders have suspended covenant tests until June 2027.

guidance.summary: Sappi expects Q1 FY2027 adjusted EBITDA to be below the Q4 level because of market conditions, planned maintenance shutdowns and higher oil prices. It gave no figures, and says some product categories are improving on firmer pricing.

points: Sappi called the year a difficult and volatile operating environment.
Dissolving pulp demand stayed strong and prices recovered in the second half; several other product lines are seeing firmer pricing.
Revised lender terms are meant to give headroom through to December 2027.
Sappi and UPM submitted remedies to the European Commission on 4 Nov for their graphic paper joint venture; a decision is expected in early January.
The Somerset mill PM2 ramp-up was slower than planned but has stabilised and is adding to profits.
call.source: Results announcement commentary as reported by Business Day, 6 Nov 2026 (no call coverage found)
